intro: Rwanda is a small, hilly, landlocked country with volcanoes, lakes and rainforest.

chapters.title: Hills and volcanoes
text: Rolling hills cover most of the country. The Virunga volcanoes in the north-west shelter mountain gorillas. Lake Kivu lies along the border with DR Congo, and Nyungwe Forest is an ancient rainforest.

chapters.title: Climate
text: High altitude gives a mild climate with two rainy seasons.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Rwanda's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
